تستطردون (form X)
# تَسْتَطْرِدُونَ (tastaṭridūna) /tas.tatˤ.ri.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# تُسْتَطْرَدُونَ (tustaṭradūna) /tus.tatˤ.ra.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
